pythonUnits.scope: Thin async host adaptation and input/trace ownership; actual scheduling delegated to B controller
Instance-local implemented subset; explicit host divergence from global cumulative reference registry
Nine fixed option descriptors with native constraints, one bounded algorithm/category, full twelve IDs used for errors only
Native code/path/message and execution categories; no broad relabeling of JS errors

hostDecisions.selectorValidation: Classify every global/local algorithm selector that the unchanged resolver actually parses, in global then local order; explicit call layoutOptions replaces constructor defaults, but a local selector does not hide an invalid selected global selector.
hostDecisions.instanceRegistry: Isolated; empty algorithm list is metadata-only; no imitation of global FakeWorker accumulation
hostDecisions.workerParameters: UnsupportedWorkerError also NotImplementedError without invoking callables
hostDecisions.inputOwnership: Snapshots and independent returned values; original JS mutation remains separate reference fact
hostDecisions.errors: Specific native code/path/message classes; internal worker errors distinct from unsupported

limitations: Runtime acceptance and independent source review pending
